prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: high-fidelity 1920 x 1080 landscape PNG mockup for an existing fantasy dungeon-crawler character sheet, for human design review, not implemented software.
Input image: reference screenshot of the CURRENT approved inventory. Treat it as the exact visual and layout reference for the outer frame, top header, close button, four-character selection strip, portraits, typography, colors and spacing.
Primary request: show the proposed CHARACTER tab of this same fullscreen paused interface. It is a sibling of INVENTORY, not a popup. Only the content BELOW the existing four-character strip is replaced on this tab. Keep the current Inventory content design unchanged when the other tab is chosen (do not draw inventory content on this active Character view).
Header: replace the old "INVENTORY & EQUIPMENT" title at upper left with two genuinely tab-like clickable headings "INVENTORY" and "CHARACTER", separated by a modest gap and subtle vertical divider. CHARACTER is active with bright warm gold lettering and a thin gold underline; INVENTORY is inactive but clearly clickable, muted gold. Both tabs occupy the current title/header band, not an extra row. Preserve PAUSED and centered X close control in their original positions.
Shared strip: preserve the same row of four equal-width boxes and identical 12-pixel gaps, aligned with header left and close button right: "1 Alden" / "Fighter", "2 Brunna" / "Cleric", "3 Merrin" / "Rogue", "4 Lethiel" / "Wizard". Preserve their painted portrait identities. Highlight MERRIN (third box) instead of Lethiel. This entire row is shared by both tabs, and switching tabs retains Merrin. Do not add any extra character selector.
Style: faithfully match the reference near-black green background, fine subdued brass borders, gold serif section headings, restrained teal accents, readable light-gray sans serif text. Flat practical game UI, no 3D perspective, no browser, no device frame, no photorealism, no new ornate decoration. Crisp legible typography. Comfortable spacing and aligned labels and numbers; no overlapping content.
Below the shared strip, design three spacious vertical areas with subtle dividers, spanning roughly y=220 to 1010:
LEFT area x=42..438: heading "MERRIN"; a larger painted bust portrait matching the hooded woman in the third selector (not a full-body character model); identity lines "Level 1 Rogue", "Lightfoot Halfling", "Rear left". Below, a compact "EXPERIENCE" section with "0 / 300 XP", an empty thin progress bar, "300 XP to level 2". Reserve breathing room in this progression area so a future level-up call-to-action can fit when eligible, but DO NOT show a level-up button or any unavailable feature text in this mockup. At bottom display "HIT DICE" and "1 / 1 d8".
CENTER area x=474..1238: heading "COMBAT"; four clear equal summary tiles in a row: "HIT POINTS" / "10 / 10", "ARMOR CLASS" / "14", "INITIATIVE" / "+3", "PROFICIENCY" / "+2".
Below heading "EQUIPPED ATTACKS"; two spacious horizontal weapon rows, with small painted weapon icons compatible with the existing item art. First "Shortsword" with "MAIN HAND", "Attack +5", "1d6 + 3 piercing", secondary "4–9 damage". Second "Shortbow" with "RANGED", "Attack +5", "1d6 + 3 piercing", secondary "4–9 damage • 20 arrows". Keep numeric attack and damage columns lined up.
Below heading "CLASS FEATURES"; one simple row "Sneak Attack" with "+1d6" and "Extra damage when Sneak Attack conditions are met." At bottom heading "ACTIVE EFFECTS", then "None".
RIGHT area x=1274..1878: heading "ABILITIES & SAVES"; clean readable six-row table, with column headers "Ability", "Score", "Modifier", "Save". Rows exactly:
"Strength" "8" "−1" "−1"
"Dexterity" "17" "+3" "+5"
"Constitution" "14" "+2" "+2"
"Intelligence" "12" "+1" "+3"
"Wisdom" "13" "+1" "+1"
"Charisma" "11" "+0" "+0"
Use teal for the proficient Dexterity and Intelligence saving throw values, with subtle legend "Teal saves include proficiency".
Below heading "PROFICIENCIES", labels "Armor" and "Weapons", values "Light armor" and wrapped "Simple weapons, longswords, rapiers, shortswords, hand crossbows".
Bottom small muted hint: "1–4: character / Esc: close". No invented controls, skill values, equipment slots, extra tabs, quests, journal, settings, or skill trees. No annotation arrows or outside explanatory text. This must look like a plausible finished sibling screen of the supplied inventory, not a redesign of the existing inventory. Text values are illustrative for this mockup; XP progression is a proposed future integration.
